_about: Numbers that the condensed note (GFF/note/long_range_ising_condensed.tex, edition fa71533 of 13 October 2026) and the paper quote (final text f496d39a: Table 1 of Sec. 3 and App. A, paper/sections/app_closed_forms.tex; "paper App. A until 2026-10-14" marks numbers of the d = 3 paragraph of App. A that the author removed that day, kept as checks of the records) for C5(3) and the d = 3 masters, and that the package GFF/code/LRI_C5_d3 produces. Read by code/LRI_C5_d3/public/replay_c5_d3.py. 'quoted' strings are copied from the TeX sources; 'where' gives section and line at fa71533. Tolerance kinds: unit_last = |value - quoted| <= one unit in the last quoted digit (the TeX truncates or rounds and marks omitted digits with \ldots); round_eq = the value rounded to the quoted number of significant digits equals the quoted string; round2 = the computed deviation, printed to two significant digits, equals the quoted figure; abs_le / rel_le = bound. Q3, P4(3), P5(3) are owned by the bundle_d3 entry (d3_specialization_quoted.json); they are re-checked here only because C5(3) uses them. Written by Claude (session C63d) on 2026-10-13 for the public release.
